name: The 6 Documents You Need Before Vibe Coding Any App
license: source page; no license declared; attributed Markdown extraction and source snapshot retained
description: A complete pre-coding planning system: App Brief, PRD, TRD, App Flow, UI/UX Brief, Backend Schema, and Implementation Plan, with copy-ready templates and prompts.
why: The most complete free workflow in this catalog for turning an idea into buildable instructions. Imported as the vibe-planning-6docs skill without paraphrasing.

name: Shape Up
license: book content copyrighted; free to read online
description: Basecamp's product development method built around shaped work, six-week cycles, and betting.
why: A strong antidote to unbounded backlogs and vague scope.

name: GitHub Spec Kit
description: Toolkit for spec-driven development with agents: specify, plan, tasks, and implement phases.
why: A concrete command workflow for teams that want specs to drive implementation.

name: BMAD Method
description: Breakthrough Method for Agile AI-Driven Development with specialized planning agents.
why: A heavier, role-based planning framework for larger agent-run projects.

name: Mermaid
description: Text-based diagrams for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, and more.
why: Diagrams that live in Markdown and can be reviewed like code.

name: Excalidraw
description: Virtual whiteboard for hand-drawn-style architecture and flow sketches.
why: Fast for early ambiguity; pairs well with the 6-documents flow.

name: Notion
why: Where many teams keep PRDs and decision logs; useful as an export source.

name: Linear
description: Fast issue tracking and project planning for software teams.
why: A clean target for turning a spec into tickets an agent can execute.

name: Jira
why: Common in existing organizations; agents often need to read or write tickets.
